Dialogs.Dialog: Geez. Are you always cutting it this close？
Well done. Come on, get up properly？ We'll be late.
Someone said he's bad with mornings, right？ Anyway, come on, get ready！
Did you forget？ I said I'd come help wake you up.
Then I'll wait outside your room, okay？
Why？ I'll get changed right away, so you can just...
Anyway, I'll wait outside. Hurry, okay？
We promised, didn't we？ That I'd come wake you. Are you still half asleep？
Yeah, my brain might not be working.
...Then maybe I'll lie down beside you until you're fully awake.
Hehe, eyes wide open. Get ready quickly, okay？
If you don't hurry, I'm leaving？
I'll be outside, so come quick, okay？
A little longer... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, you too, come on...
Geez... Just a little, okay？ After a little, get up, okay？
Hehe. Funny, watching you makes me want to curl up and sleep too.
Hehe, geez. Come on, wake up？ We'll be late, you know？
Hey, have you bought lunch yet？
If you want, would you eat this？
A bento？ Did ▲高嶺＊＊▲ make it？ Seriously！
Ah, sorry. I got so happy.
Then I guess it can't be helped？ Hehe. It's Japanese food, is that okay？
Um, well. I was wondering what you're doing for lunch today...
I was about to go buy something...
Good. This. I'd like you to eat it...
A bento？ Did you maybe make it for me？
If it's not to your taste, tell me, okay？
Hey, did you already buy lunch？
Huh. Oh... Is this a homemade bento？
Hehe. It's Japanese food, the total opposite of bread.
Whoa, amazing！ The real deal. Thanks, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
You're welcome. If it's not to your taste, tell me？ I'll try harder next time.
Yeah, delicious. The broth really comes through, and the seasoning has depth...
Geez, how many times is that？
It's really good, so I can't help it, right？
I see. You can't help it, eh？ Hehe！
Today's bento is great too！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s simmered dishes are the best.
Hey, what kind of bento would you like next？
Everything ▲高嶺＊＊▲ makes is delicious, so...
Really？ I'm so happy... Then I'll do my best next time too？
Perfect. ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s seasoning is the best.
Hehe, very good. Just kidding. What should I make next？ Any requests？
Hehe, hey there. Today I brought a bento.
A bento？ Then I'll go buy bread at the school store.
That's not what I meant. Here.
Whoa, a Western-style lunch！ Looks great！ Can I eat it？
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Wait a sec, I'll run to the school store, then lunch together...
Wait. I figured you'd do that, so I hurried over too.
Ah, is there something you want me to get？
No, it's not that. I'd like you to eat this.
Yes. It's Western-style... but please enjoy, if you'd like.
Hehe, when you look that happy, it makes me happy too. Here you go.
Hehe, I came to kidnap you.
Me？ You won't get any ransom, you know？
Yes. I wanted to have lunch with you. How about it？
I'm drooling... This smell says Western-style.
Ahh, that was good！ Can't wait for the next one.
You're really good at motivating me, aren't you？
Because I really am looking forward to it. Every time I eat, I discover something new...
Yes. I thought I'd like you to try lots of different things. ...How is it？
Delicious！ The last one was good, but this one's exactly my taste too.
...I'm glad. I hope I can keep growing my repertoire like this.
Yeah, good again today. Is it okay for it to be this good？
You can praise me more, you know？
I want to eat more of ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s cooking.
Hehe. Roger that. You can look forward to it▼
If you don't want it, I'll eat it alone.
Um, it's Chinese food. Is that okay？
Of course！ Chinese food made by ▲高嶺＊＊▲... Looks great...
Save your thoughts until after you eat, please. Go ahead？
Um. Hey, did you already go buy lunch？
No, I was about to. Huh？ What's that you're holding？
...Yes. I made a bento. Want to share？
Oh, thanks！ What is it, by the way？
Chinese. You said before you like food that fills you up, right？
Whoa, fancy. I'll gratefully dig in.
Okay. Tell me how it was when you're done？
I want to know what you like.
Sure. Then wait a sec. I'll run to the store...
No need. I have one for you.
If you're not in the mood for Chinese, the school store...
Hehe. If you make that face, I guess it was worth all the effort？
Then let's eat. I want to hear what you think, so really taste it, okay？
Delicious！ Your cooking keeps getting better, I swear.
Hehe. Isn't that because of the spice？
Yes, you know the saying？ Hehe, eat up, okay？
Hehe, you're such a smooth talker. ...How are today's side dishes？
...Delicious！ The kind of delicious that makes you feel happy？
Hearing you say that makes me happy too. Hehe.
Mm, today's Chinese is great too！
But isn't it a lot of work every time？ Such a fancy bento... I'm happy, though.
Not at all. Because your smile is a feast for me.
...Just kidding. Hey, what do you want to eat next？
